name: Structure and Function of Cellular Biomolecules
description: Amino acids structure and properties, protein structure and function: hemoglobin, myoglobin, collagen, keratin, protein purification. Structures of DNA and RNA. PCR and DNA sequencing. Enzyme kinetics, regulation, and inhibition. Bacterial growth, quorum sensing, and biofilm.
